build_jumpcnf_model: build a JumpCNF continuous normalizing flow model with configurable hidden dimensions and tolerance
compute_conditional_logprob: compute conditional log probabilities for event times and spatial locations using JumpCNF logprob
get_spatial_logprob_fn: get a spatial conditional log probability function at time t from JumpCNF spatial_conditional_logprob_fn
get_vector_field_fn: get the vector field function at time t from JumpCNF vector_field_fn for spatial locations
compute_gaussian_loglik: compute the Gaussian log-likelihood of tensor z given mean and log standard deviation
